description: This PHP source file defines the ImportMapOutlook class, which extends ImportMapOther and specifies import mappings specific to Outlook files within the SuiteCRM import module. It includes configuration properties like delimiter, enclosure, and header presence, and overrides getMapping() for module-specific field mappings.

classes.name: ImportMapOutlook
classes.description: A class extending ImportMapOther that manages import mappings for Outlook files, including configuration properties and a method for module-specific field mappings.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns module-specific field mappings, extending the parent class's getMapping() with additional mappings for 'Contacts' and 'Leads'.
